lines.text: Josiah became king in Jerusalem at eight years old and did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
In his twelfth year as king, Josiah began to cleanse Judah and Jerusalem of the high places and idols.
Josiah crushed the idols to dust and scattered it over the fields, then burned the priests' bones on their altars.
Josiah tore down altars and crushed idols in Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, as far as Zebulun.
Josiah sent men to repair the house of the LORD, and Levites supervised the workers task by task.
